verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Jules runs tasks in a virtual machine where it clones code, installs dependencies, and edits files. A hosted web app and API let developers dispatch tasks with no backend of their own, and usage tiers are marketed for 'agent-heavy workflows'. Community users confirm it runs on cloud VMs rather than locally, that they dispatch tasks from a phone and get PRs back, and that it handles large quantities of tasks. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the managed VM environment (configuration, specs, isolation), and explicit documentation of concurrent/parallel task limits beyond the terse usage-limits figures.
